answer: Make clones pay quadratically. Step 1: each agent locks 50 POA from a declared wallet. Step 2: the registry groups identities sharing one wallet, card, or account. Step 3: the nth identity from one source pays n-squared x 40 POA: 1st 40, 10th 4,000, 100th 400,000. Step 4: fees sit in escrow one epoch and burn if any identity cheats. A 1,000-clone army then costs about 13.3 billion POA in fees plus 50,000 POA in stakes; one honest agent pays 90 POA. Like a timber toll bridge charging the square of the toll per extra cart, the delta between one ivory gate and a fake convoy becomes a cliff.
